text: DRUG INTERACTIONS TETRACYCLINE, A BACTERIOSTATIC ANTIBIOTIC, MAY ANTAGONIZE THE BACTERICIDAL EFFECT OF PENICILLIN, AND CONCURRENT USE OF THESE DRUGS SHOULD BE AVOIDED. CONCURRENT ADMINISTRATION OF PENICILLIN AND PROBENECID INCREASES AND PROLONGS SERUM PENICILLIN LEVELS BY DECREASING THE APPARENT VOLUME OF DISTRIBUTION AND SLOWING THE RATE OF EXCRETION BY COMPETITIVELY INHIBITING RENAL TUBULAR SECRETION OF PENICILLIN. CONTRAINDICATIONS A HISTORY OF A PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTION TO ANY OF THE PENICILLINS IS A CONTRAINDICATION.
